name: Purchases consistent with attack preparation reported by authorities
description: Spending on items or services that match typologies shared by law enforcement or public-private partnerships, such as particular combinations of retail goods, vehicle hire and reconnaissance-type travel.
fp: Individual purchases are lawful; only the combination, timing and external intel make it meaningful.
